findings.title: Cache overwritten with nil on read failure
findings.body: When readWebAssetsFromFile/CDN fails, result is nil and it is still assigned to entryPointAssetsCache, clobbering a previously good cached value and forcing every subsequent request to re-read the manifest (and return nil). Guard the assignment with `if result != nil` / `err == nil`.

findings.title: No re-check of cache after acquiring write lock
findings.body: After taking the write lock the function does not re-verify that entryPointAssetsCache is still nil. Concurrent cold-start requests will each serialize on the mutex and redundantly parse/fetch the manifest (including an HTTP request in the CDN case) even though an earlier goroutine already populated the cache.
